about_the_game:
Speed Rally – Classic Arcade Racing, Reimagined!

Speed Rally is a fast-paced, retro-inspired top-down arcade racer that brings back the golden era of single-button gaming. Whether you're chasing online high scores or battling friends in local multiplayer, Speed Ralley delivers an exciting, pick-up-and-play racing experience that’s easy to learn but hard to master.

Race Across Diverse Tracks

Compete on a variety of tracks set in woodlands, deserts, and tropical islands. Choose from different car models and put your skills to the test in CPU races or time trial mode, where every millisecond counts.

Compete with Friends

Take on a friend in local multiplayer with two exciting modes. Play in split-screen or crank up the intensity with Penalty Mode, where both players race on the same screen—fall too far behind, and you're out!

Climb the Leaderboards

Challenge yourself to master every track and push for the fastest lap times. Can you claim the top spot and become the ultimate Speed Ralley champion?

Jump in and start racing today!
